fix_guidance: Remove duplicated rows from the upload: the same registration was submitted or delivered twice.
plain_action: Remove duplicate rows before sending the file.

fix_guidance: The same player is registered twice in one league and season under different ids: keep one registration per player.
plain_action: Keep one registration per player each season.

fix_guidance: Correct the date of birth: it is in the future or implies an age over 80.
plain_action: Correct birth dates that fall in the future or make a player over 80.

fix_guidance: Send dates of birth as YYYY-MM-DD with a four-digit year: the value could not be read without guessing.
plain_action: Send birth dates as year-month-day with a four-digit year.

fix_guidance: Collect a birth year: the file carries a division but no date of birth, so age bands and retention cannot be computed.
plain_label: Division given but no birth year
plain_action: Collect each player's birth year as well as the division.

fix_guidance: Collect gender (with a prefer-not-to-say option): girls' participation cannot be reported without it, and blanks are not random.
plain_action: Ask for gender on the form and offer a prefer-not-to-say option.

fix_guidance: Require a ZIP (at least the first three digits) on the registration form: without it a registration cannot be placed in a club market.
plain_action: Require at least the first three digits of the ZIP on the form.

fix_guidance: Use a division label from the standard list: the label is not in division_map.
plain_action: Pick the division from the standard list.

fix_guidance: Use M, F, X or U for gender: the value is not in gender_map.
plain_action: Use M, F, X or U for gender.

fix_guidance: Use an ISO country code: the value is not in country_map.
plain_action: Use the two-letter country code.

fix_guidance: Pick the division from a list instead of typing it: spreadsheet labels map only to a coarse age band.
plain_action: Let people pick the division from a list instead of typing it.

fix_guidance: Use one spelling of the country on a sheet (repaired in staging through country_map).
plain_action: Use one spelling of each country in the file.

fix_guidance: Store ZIPs and postal codes as text in the standard form (repaired in staging).
plain_label: ZIP code in the wrong format
plain_action: Store ZIP codes as text so leading zeros are kept.

fix_guidance: Trim and lower-case emails at capture (repaired in staging).
plain_label: Email has stray spaces or capitals
plain_action: Trim and lower-case emails when they are typed in.

fix_guidance: Capture names in normal case (repaired in staging).
plain_action: Capture names in normal capital and lower-case letters.

fix_guidance: Export dates as dates, not spreadsheet serial numbers (decoded in staging).

plain_action: Export dates as dates, not as spreadsheet serial numbers.

fix_guidance: Capture photo and media consent as an explicit yes or no; a blank is recorded as not captured, never as no.
plain_action: Record photo permission as a clear yes or no.

fix_guidance: Capture the marketing choice as an explicit yes or no on every registration; a household with no recorded choice cannot be contacted.
plain_action: Record each family's marketing choice as a clear yes or no.

fix_guidance: Report each programme year, event or account once.
plain_action: Send each program, year or event once.

fix_guidance: Make the total equal girls plus boys, and send counted figures, not round estimates.

plain_action: Make the total equal girls plus boys, and send counts rather than estimates.

fix_guidance: Report the grade band of each programme.
plain_action: Report the grade band of each program.

fix_guidance: Deliver events in the month they happened.
plain_label: Events arrive in the wrong month
plain_action: Deliver events in the month they happened.

fix_guidance: Timestamp consent changes in order; every refund must name its original transaction.
plain_action: Timestamp consent changes in the order they happen.

plain_label: Title or total rows in data
plain_action: Send data rows only, with no titles, blanks or totals.

fix_guidance: Send the canonical organization id with every registration: records that cannot be attributed to an organization cannot be fixed at the source.
plain_action: Send the official league id with every registration.

fix_guidance: Collect a birth year, an age group or a grade: participation by age band cannot be reported without one.
plain_action: Collect a birth year, an age group or a school grade.

fix_guidance: Collect one parent email: without it the household cannot be reached.
plain_action: Collect one parent email for every registration.

fix_guidance: Validate the ZIP on entry: it is not a known ZIP.
plain_action: Check the ZIP code against a list when it is entered.

fix_guidance: Validate the email on entry: it is malformed and cannot be used.
plain_action: Check email addresses for the right shape when they are entered.

fix_guidance: The same child is registered more than once in a season term, here or through another channel: agree one registration channel per child.
plain_action: Make sure each child registers once per season.

fix_guidance: Register players before the season starts: late registrations arrive after the data cut.
plain_action: Open registration early enough for players to join before the season starts.

fix_guidance: The child's date of birth differs between registrations: reconcile with the parent.
plain_action: Ask the parent which birth date is right and fix it.

fix_guidance: The child's gender differs between registrations.
plain_action: Confirm each child's gender with the parent.

fix_guidance: The home ZIP differs between registrations: confirm the family's address.
plain_action: Confirm the family's address with them.

fix_guidance: The age group contradicts the child's date of birth in another registration.
plain_action: Check the age group against the birth date.

fix_guidance: This organization sent no file this season: its players are missing from every count.
plain_action: Send this season's registration file, in any format.

fix_guidance: Record a consent with every registration: without one nobody knows what the parent agreed to.
plain_action: Record consent with every registration.

fix_guidance: Record which consent wording (version) the parent saw.
plain_action: Record which consent form version each family signed.

fix_guidance: Record when consent was given.
plain_action: Record the date and time each family gave consent.

fix_guidance: A marketing opt-in was recorded on a form whose wording has no club-marketing purpose: it is not evidence of that consent. Use a form that names the purpose.
